title: Product Manager, Developer Ecosystem
description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com .
 About the Team
 Reddit's developer ecosystem is one of the biggest opportunities to make Reddit more useful, expressive, extensible, and valuable. Today, most people who build on Reddit are developers: they write code, use Devvit, work with APIs, and ship apps or games through a relatively technical workflow. That ecosystem is growing quickly and remains critical.
 But the future is bigger than developers alone. AI-assisted building is changing who can create software. The next generation of Reddit apps, games, tools, community agents, content formats, and workflows should be buildable by many more people: developers, technically curious creators, moderators, community builders, game designers, data partners, and eventually people who can describe what they want without needing to code it by hand.
 The Developer Ecosystem team owns the product systems that help this broader set of builders discover opportunities, create successfully, launch high-quality apps and games, reach the right users and communities, adopt new platform capabilities, and keep improving after launch. This includes surfaces and systems like developers.reddit.com, AI-assisted creation, app review, developer and creator onboarding, app marketplace experiences, platform capabilities, best practices, and support for emerging creator categories.

title: Customer Experience Associate, Core Services Resolutions Desk
description:
Join us in building the future of finance.
 Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.
 About the team + role
 Robinhood's Customer Experience team is committed to providing world-class service to our internal and external customers. The Resolutions Desk supports our customer experience associates by providing real-time education, resolving escalated situations, and acting as a resource when exceptions are needed.
 As a CX Associate, Resolutions Desk, you'll be the first line of live support for our CX agents, helping them navigate customer questions across chat, email, and phone. You'll follow documented policies and playbooks to give agents fast, accurate answers, and escalations are part of the role from day one. As you build experience, you'll take on a growing share of escalation work and more complex cases over time. This is an unlicensed role.
 What you'll do day-to-day
 Serve as a real-time point of contact for CX agents across chat, email, and phone, answering questions according to well-defined policies, procedures, and escalation playbooks.
 Handle escalations as part of your regular workload from day one, resolving straightforward cases and building fluency for more complex ones over time.
 Apply a teaching-vs-telling approach so agents walk away better equipped to handle similar questions independently next time.
 Recognize when a situation calls for a supervisor and route it promptly.
 Issue goodwill credits and refunds within your authorized limits, escalating anything beyond that to your manager.
 Log and track your interactions accurately to support clear case history and smooth handoffs.
 Flag recurring agent questions or process gaps to your manager to help surface patterns worth addressing.

description:

 Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. title: Nebenjob als Online-Testbenutzer (m/w/d) - Studien für Apps, Websites & digitale Produkte
description:
Wie gut funktionieren neue Apps? Sind Websites verständlich aufgebaut? Und wie kommen neue Produkte bei Nutzern wirklich an?
 Genau solche Fragen untersuchen Unternehmen gemeinsam mit der Plattform TestingTime . Dafür werden regelmäßig Menschen gesucht, die neue digitale Angebote testen und ihre Eindrücke teilen.
 Als Online-Testbenutzer unterstützt du Studien zu Apps, Websites oder digitalen Services und gibst ehrliches Feedback aus Sicht eines Nutzers.
 Aufgaben
 Teilnahme an Online-Studien zu Apps, Websites oder digitalen Produkten
 Teilen deiner Eindrücke und Erfahrungen als Nutzer
 Bewertung von Bedienbarkeit, Design und Verständlichkeit
 Beantwortung kurzer Fragen oder Teilnahme an moderierten Online-Interviews
 Teilnahme bequem von zuhause oder gelegentlich vor Ort (je nach Studie)
 Qualifikation
 Das solltest du mitbringen
 Interesse an digitalen Produkten, Apps oder neuen Services
 Einen PC, Laptop oder ein Smartphone mit Internetzugang
 Zuverlässigkeit bei vereinbarten Studienterminen
 Bereitschaft, deine Meinung ehrlich und nachvollziehbar zu teilen
 Vorkenntnisse sind nicht erforderlich – wichtig ist vor allem deine Perspektive als Nutzer.
 Benefits
 Das erwartet dich
 ✔ Flexible Teilnahme – du entscheidest selbst, an welchen Studien du teilnimmst
✔ Vergütung pro Studie – Höhe abhängig von Dauer und Art der Untersuchung
✔ Unterschiedliche Themen rund um Apps, Websites und digitale Services
✔ Teilnahme meist bequem online von zuhause aus
✔ Keine Verpflichtungen – du kannst Studienangebote annehmen oder ablehnen
 Diese Tätigkeit eignet sich gut als Nebenverdienst neben Studium, Beruf oder Selbstständigkeit , wenn du gelegentlich an Studien teilnehmen möchtest und Interesse daran hast, neue Produkte frühzeitig kennenzulernen.
